context.title: Solana Beach Chamber of Commerce: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Solana Beach — Measure C (Solana Beach Transient Occupancy Tax Measure)

positions.statement: Gregory Petre (Co-Chair Solana Beach Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors 47 year resident) signed the argument in favor of Solana Beach Measure C in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
